# Scenario selection window: icon areas are no longer accessible

### Describe the bug

In the scenario selection dialog, right-clicking on the icon columns no longer works correctly. The exact incorrect behavior is visible in the screenshots below.

The screenshots below were captured while reproducing the bug:

![Screenshot 1](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_1.png)
![Screenshot 2](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_2.png)
![Screenshot 3](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_3.png)
![Screenshot 4](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_4.png)

![Screenshot 5](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_5.png)
![Screenshot 6](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_6.png)

![Screenshot 7](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_7.png)
![Screenshot 8](/app/.harbor_assets/bug_8.png)

Fix the scenario selection dialog so that right-clicking on each icon area works correctly, matching the expected behavior shown in the screenshots. The file-location/map-type popup shown in the screenshots should not be removed -- it should still be reachable by right-clicking elsewhere on the row, matching what the screenshots show. The incorrect behavior shown in the screenshots may not be confined to the areas shown above -- check the rest of the dialog for any other right-click area that could be similarly affected, and make sure your fix leaves each of them working as it did before.

One more thing worth checking while you're in this dialog. In the panel below the list that describes the currently selected map, check whether the "Map difficulty" label still sits where the screenshots show it, relative to the panel.

The list's item area `rtAreaItems` = `Rect(rt.x+55, rt.y+55, 270, 175)`. In `ListBox::QueueEventProcessing` (called first, at line 330), any right-press within `rtAreaItems` calls `ActionListPressRight`, which shows the **Location/Map Type** popup and returns — preempting the per-column right-click checks (lines 414-434) in the dialog loop.

- `countPlayers` rt.x+45..64 — only its leftmost part (rt.x+45..55) is *outside* `rtAreaItems`, so only there does the "Players Icon" popup still show (screenshot 2). The rest is swallowed.
- `sizeMaps` (rt.x+64..83), `mapType` (rt.x+83..102), `victoryConds` (rt.x+268..287), `lossConds` (rt.x+287..306) — all fully inside `rtAreaItems`, so right-clicking them shows the Location popup instead of their own popup (screenshots 4/6/8).

The fix: the ScenarioListBox's `ActionListPressRight` (Location popup) should only fire for the **map-name region** of the row, letting the icon columns fall through to the dialog loop's per-column checks. Let me use the position-aware override.

content.text:
The fix is in place and compiles. Let me summarize.

## What was wrong

In the scenario selection dialog, each list row has icon columns (player count, map size, map type, victory condition, loss condition) plus the map name in the middle. Right-clicking each icon column is supposed to show that icon's own help popup — and those handlers exist in the dialog loop (`dialog_selectscenario.cpp:414-434`).

The problem: `listbox.QueueEventProcessing()` runs first, and in `ListBox::QueueEventProcessing` (`interface_list.h:429`) **any** right-press anywhere inside the item area (`rtAreaItems` = `rt.x+55 … rt.x+325`) calls `ActionListPressRight`, which pops up the **Location / Map Type** dialog and returns — preempting the per-column checks.

Because the item area starts at `rt.x+55`, the columns fell into it:
- **Player count** (`rt.x+45..64`): only its leftmost 10px stuck out of the item area, so only there did the "Players Icon" popup still appear (screenshot 2). The rest was swallowed.
- **Size, map type, victory, loss** columns: entirely inside the item area → all showed the Location popup instead of their own help (screenshots 4/6/8).

## The fix

I overrode the position-aware `ScenarioListBox::ActionListPressRight`, so the Location/Map-Type popup only fires when the right-click lands in the **map-name band** of the row (between the map-type icon column and the victory column). For clicks on the icon columns it returns without doing anything, so control falls back to the dialog loop's per-column checks and each icon column shows its own popup again (Players Icon, Size Icon, Map Type, Victory Condition, Loss Condition).

The boundaries (`itemOffsetX+47` … `itemOffsetX+213`) are aligned to the existing column rects (`mapType`'s right edge and `victoryConds`' left edge), so there's no gap or overlap. The Location/Map-Type popup remains reachable by right-clicking the name area, exactly as the screenshots show. I checked the whole dialog: every right-click column region (including the panel-below `cur*` regions and the size-filter buttons) is unaffected since those are outside the list's item area and were never intercepted.

## "Map difficulty" label

I checked `RedrawBackground` (`dialog_selectscenario.cpp:197-198`): the label is drawn right-aligned at `dst.x + 180 - text.w()` on line `dst.y + 290`, with the difficulty value centered at `dst.x + 275` on the same line — the label sitting left-of-center under the map name, value under the victory/loss column. That matches where the screenshots show it, and my change doesn't touch this code, so the label is correctly positioned and unchanged.
